data.diagnostics: two distinct known keys chosen from serialized dev statements, one absent-subject key ED999 + known relation, one known-subject key + absent relation violet; raw dense scores over every serialized record, including obsolete records
data.end_to_end: unchanged MUC v2 BM25 top4 + same neural matcher + public timestamp tie + threshold0.5 + explicit path loop; 16 questions/world, 2 absent-subject UNKNOWN questions
data.realized_seed_policy: five runner_random_v1 seeds sampled once after source freeze; reject any historical MUC seed collision before fit; no resampling
data.seed_derivation: integer SHA256 of MUC02-NEGATIVES-REPLICATION-20261006-V1|seed|split|K|D|index, optional |proposal=n; first16 bytes plus2**128; parametric unchanged muc03_task, no old/calibration/final worlds
data.source: unchanged MUC v2 task grammar and strata; fresh TAG for all five paired train/dev units; ED dev and ET train prefixes preserved
data.structural_construction: Same prospectively frozen conditional law as the old comparison: accept first graph satisfying fixed query strata among at most64 hash-bound proposals; every rejected proposal fsynced. Only query-strata RuntimeError permits another construction proposal. No model/outcome selection, runner seed substitution, fit/execution retry or sample filtering. Exhaustion/other failure stops all unstarted roles.
data.top1_rule: maximum probability; exact tie resolved by largest public timestamp; correct only if chosen latest record for queried key; top1 measured before fixed rejection threshold
data.unknown_rule: reject iff maximum probability < 0.5; threshold never fitted or swept

decision_gates.decision: KEEP hard sampling as dev recipe only if all primary and safety gates pass. Otherwise DISCARD this proposed recipe or INCONCLUSIVE on invalid/partial data. No architecture promotion; further fresh final experiment requires user authority.

measurement.amortization: fit divided among135 dev worlds per learned seed; world ingest once + 16 E2E queries repeated R=1/4/16; dense diagnostic work reported separately; evaluation work never hidden as free preprocessing
measurement.energy: not measured; no energy/currency/economic advantage claim
measurement.full_boundary: fresh-data generation timing, model initialization/fit/pair preprocessing, ingest/index/update, B1 end-to-end and dense diagnostics, warmup, output decoding, CPU/RAM/GPU/VRAM; exact parser/index counters separated from estimated FLOPs; raw world costs and latencies retained

metrics.aggregation: per-world diagnostic metrics then equal means of 9 KxD cells; end-to-end 16 questions per world; per-seed arm differences, never pool queries as independent replicates
metrics.uncertainty: five independent paired seed/data units; Student-t df=4. Both primaries use two-sided 97.5% intervals (Bonferroni familywise 95% for two endpoints). Secondaries 95% paired t descriptive; no query-level binomial claims

negative_sampling.hard: 2048 negatives: 1024 same-subject/different-relation and 1024 same-relation/different-subject; uniform within each type
negative_sampling.pairing: independent RNGs for anchor selection, negative selection and global pair permutation; same 2048 positives, document anchors, label order, initialization and minibatches in each pair
negative_sampling.random: uniform different known (subject,relation) key from the same world
negative_sampling.unknown_training: none added; absent keys remain dev-only; changed factor is negative key distribution only

recipe.frozen_control: same initialization and inference as BM25 pair reader; zero updates
recipe.retrieval: actual BM25 k1=1.2 b=0.75, top 4; identical learned pair model and disclosed iterative path loop
recipe.sampling: 4096 balanced pairs; identical anchors/positives/order; only negative key distribution differs
recipe.seed_source: five runner_random_v1 paired seeds, same initialization and batches within pair
recipe.selection: none; fixed final optimizer step; dev evaluated once for competence only
